archetypes.name: dyn-skill-surface
archetypes.rationale: Many public and dev-only skill prompts now load a shared readability authority.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed skill prompt surfaces for correct public versus dev-only path forms. Check that added directives do not alter machine-parsed output contracts or step control flow. Pay special attention to design and implement anchors that are counted by the lint manifest. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
